cards.name: Updating your contact details or name

content.text: You'll need to call us and let us know your new email.

points: Go to your contact details in the website or app
Enter your new phone number or home address
If you're updating your phone number, you'll need to verify your new phone number by entering a code we'll send you.

content.text: If you're an owner and moving where your car is parked, see these instructions for updating your car's parking address.

subsections.name: Updating your name or preferred name

content.text: If you have a preferred first name you'd like displayed on the website, you can update it on the website (not app):

numbers: Log in to the website (not app)
Select on the menu in the top right-hand corner and choose Account
Select on your name under your profile photo
Type your preferred name into the box

content.text: Your preferred name will display on your profile, on any reviews you leave for other members or cars, and on your car's profile.
